disclaimer: Rules evaluate supplied policy text for educational risk signals. They do not determine legal applicability or compliance.

rules.title: Location or device identifier collection disclosed
rules.explanation: The policy describes collection of location information or device identifiers.
rules.next_step: Review the stated purpose, retention period, and available controls for these data categories.

rules.title: Advertising or third-party sharing disclosed
concern_patterns: share your personal information with advertising
share personal information with third parties
share your personal information with third parties
sell or share your personal information
exclusions: do not share personal information with advertising
we do not sell or share
do not sell your personal information
rules.explanation: The policy describes sharing personal information for advertising or with third parties.
rules.next_step: Review whether applicable opt-out choices and sharing purposes are explained.

regulations.reference: Right to opt-out of sale or sharing

rules.title: Cookies or tracking technology disclosed
rules.explanation: The policy describes using cookies or other tracking technology.
rules.next_step: Review the stated purposes and available controls for tracking technologies.

rules.title: Arbitration or class-action waiver language
concern_patterns: waive your right to participate in a class action
rules.explanation: The policy contains language that may limit access to courts or class actions.
rules.next_step: Review the complete dispute-resolution terms and available alternatives.

rules.title: Broad liability waiver language
rules.explanation: The policy includes broad language limiting liability or requiring a waiver.
rules.next_step: Review the scope and exceptions for the stated liability terms.

rules.title: Unilateral policy-change language
concern_patterns: change this privacy policy at any time
modify this policy at any time
update this policy at any time
rules.explanation: The policy reserves a broad right to change privacy terms.
rules.next_step: Review notification practices and whether changes take effect prospectively.

rules.title: Consent choice described
rules.explanation: The policy describes a consent-related choice.
rules.next_step: Review whether consent is specific, informed, and can be withdrawn.

rules.title: Open-ended retention language
concern_patterns: as long as necessary for business purposes
rules.explanation: The policy uses open-ended retention wording rather than a stated period or clear criteria.
rules.next_step: Review the complete policy for retention periods or criteria that qualify this statement.

rules.title: Access or deletion request described
rules.explanation: The policy describes a way to request access to or deletion of personal information.
rules.next_step: Review eligibility, verification, timing, and exceptions in the complete policy.

rules.title: Sale or sharing opt-out control described
positive_patterns: opt out of sale or sharing
rules.explanation: The policy describes an opt-out control related to sale or sharing.
rules.next_step: Review whether the control is applicable, accessible, and explained in context.

regulations.reference: Right to opt-out of sale or sharing

rules.title: Purpose-of-processing language described
positive_patterns: we process your personal data to
rules.explanation: The policy describes a purpose for processing information.
rules.next_step: Review whether the policy explains all material purposes and relevant choices clearly.
